policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Shepherd had not lost until Millersville came to town on opening night and left with a fourth win from five matches. Shippensburg, unbeaten themselves, beat Bloomsburg the same evening, and between them they hold every point the table has yet awarded.
Millersville have scored more than any other programme while conceding three goals in five matches; the scoring and the tightest defence sit at the same end of the chart.
Lock Haven have scored eight and conceded eleven without winning in four matches, and six different players have scored for them.
